summary: Bring projected September spend under the $2,000 account-wide hard cap with headroom for Maximize Clicks overdelivery, cutting Patio exposure first.

evidence.cap_is_already_breached_on_paper: At the current $66.00/day combined budget the projection is $2030.36, which is $30.36 over the $2,000 cap before any overdelivery.
evidence.maximize_clicks_overdelivers: Observed daily account spend above the $66 combined budget on 2026-08-22 ($103.21) and 2026-09-03 ($122.59, still partial).
evidence.why_patio_is_cut_first: August Patio spent $949.84 for 1 raw credit at 1.16% CVR. All-time, Patio is $586 per credit against Pavers' $296 ($457 after removing Pavers' 3 wrong-service credits).
evidence.counter_evidence_recorded: Patio buys cheaper clicks ($13.98 vs $22.76 in September), carries a smaller wrong-service share ($234.01 vs $331.78 of visible spend), and holds the account's best converting keyword, 'patio pavers contractor' PHRASE, at 3 credits on $314.39. The cut is deliberately modest for that reason: Patio keeps 73% of its budget.

risk: Lower budgets reduce daily click volume in an account already buying only 3-6 clicks a day. This is accepted because the cap is an owner instruction and PLAN-SLM-NEG-1 plus PLAN-SLM-BID-1 recover click volume per dollar.
rollback: Restore 33000000 on both budgets through a new approved plan.
validation: google-ads validate_only on the two campaign_budget mutations
unchanged: bidding, delivery method, the four paused campaigns and their budgets, all keywords, negatives, ads, conversions
